column1: # ESP-IDF Partition Table — 16MB flash: dual-OTA + esp-sr model store.
# nvs keeps its standard offset so Wi-Fi creds / hostname / settings survive OTA
# partition swaps. Two 3MB app slots (the app + esp-sr link in well under that).
# The "model" SPIFFS partition holds the WakeNet + VAD model data; esp-sr's build
# integration finds it *by the name "model"* and flashes srmodels.bin into it
# the app mounts it via esp_srmodel_init("model"). 6MB leaves room to add MultiNet
